record.question: Consider the following statements: (i) Third-party insurance is compulsory for all vehicle-owners as per the Motor Vehicles Act. (ii) It covers only the owner legal liability for the damage that may cause to a third party - bodily injury, death, and damage to third party property – while using the vehicle. (iii) Motor Vehicle Act, 1988, under section 145(g), "third party" includes the Government.
